title: 第二十一章 异能大普查第二十二章 判刑再次入梦
slug: 共梦星际大佬后娇娇夜夜被宠哭
content_zh:
因为刚睡醒，她整个人透着一股慵懒的娇憨。
最要命的是，头顶那一对粉色的长毛兔耳朵，因为精神放松还没收回去。
软趴趴地垂在脑后，随着她的走动一颤一颤的。
她站在楼梯口，一脸茫然地看着楼下的闹剧，声音软糯沙哑：“发生什么事了？”
苍冥原本满肚子脏话，正准备对着那个“恶毒村姑”输出。
然而，在看到楼梯上那个身影的瞬间，他像是被人突然掐住了脖子，彻底失声了。
少女肌肤胜雪，在晨光下仿佛在发光。
那双眼眸湿漉漉的，像只受惊的小鹿，无辜又纯欲。
那对粉色的兔耳朵更是萌得让人心颤，直击灵魂。
这……这就是那个传说中恶毒丑陋的真千金？
苍冥的心脏猛地漏跳了一拍。
说起来，两家原本的婚约，对象应该是他和沈家真千金才对。
只是后来因为沈若冰的存在，加上以为真千金是个废材，这婚约才不了了之。
如果是这样的小雌性……
苍冥喉结剧烈滚动了一下，脸瞬间红透了，一直红到了脖子根。
心里涌起一股巨大的，难以言喻的悔意。
如果当初他坚持一下履行婚约，现在这个萌死人的小兔子，是不是就是他的了？
苍珏正冷眼看着弟弟发疯，却敏锐地察觉到苍冥看自家媳妇的眼神不对劲。
那是雄性看到心仪雌性时特有的痴迷与惊艳。
“哼。”

苍珏冷哼一声，金色的眸子瞬间眯起，周身气压骤降。
他一步跨出，高大的身躯直接挡在苍冥面前。
隔绝了他看向沈如卿的视线，释放出ss级的恐怖威压，冷冷警告道：“苍冥，注意你的眼神。
这是你未来的嫂嫂，也是我的雌主，你该尊重她。”
“嫂……嫂嫂？”
苍冥被亲哥的威压震得后退两步，脸色惨白。
他这才悲哀地发现，他迟了一步。
女神不仅变成了嫂子，还是大哥捧在手心里的宝。
最终，他也没能给沈若冰出气，甚至不敢再看沈如卿一眼，灰溜溜地走了，背影狼狈至极。
沈若冰的上诉被驳回，即日押往第二监狱。
当晚，夜色如墨。
沈如卿躺在床上入睡，意识却再次被那股熟悉的力量拉扯。
这一次，不再是冰冷的雪原，而是一处位于帝国星的豪华宅邸，充满了冷硬的金属风格。
墨临已经从流放地回归，正处于精神力不稳的躁动期。
卧室内一片狼藉，名贵的家具被砸得粉碎。
墨临赤着上身坐在床边，银发凌乱，赤瞳猩红，如同一头受伤且极度危险的孤狼，周身缭绕着狂暴的雷霆。
沈如卿站在门口，心跳加速。
她虽然害怕，但想到现实中墨临已经开始怀疑她，甚至追到了苍珏的别墅。
如果不彻底打消他的疑虑，让他认为“梦境是梦境，现实是现实”，她迟早会翻车。
“拼了。”

沈如卿深吸一口气，一反常态。
她没有像现实中那样惊恐逃跑，而是大胆地冲过去，像一只扑火的飞蛾，主动抱住了那个处于狂暴边缘的雄性。
“墨临……”
content_en:
Because she had just woken up, her whole body exuded a lazy and charming look.
The most terrible thing is that the pair of pink long-haired rabbit ears on the top of the head have not been taken back because the spirit is relaxed.
It hung softly on the back of her head, trembling as she moved.
She stood at the top of the stairs, looking at the farce downstairs with a blank look on her face, her voice soft and hoarse: "What happened?"
Cang Ming was full of curse words and was about to speak out to that "evil village girl".
However, the moment he saw the figure on the stairs, he seemed to have been suddenly strangled by the neck, and he completely lost his voice.
The girl's skin was better than snow and seemed to glow in the morning light.
Those eyes were wet, like a frightened deer, innocent and pure.
The pair of pink bunny ears are so cute that it makes your heart tremble and touches your soul.
This...is this the vicious and ugly real daughter in the legend?
Cang Ming's heart skipped a beat.
Speaking of which, the original marriage contract between the two families should have been between him and the true daughter of the Shen family.
It was only because of Shen Ruobing's existence and the belief that the real daughter was a loser that the engagement fell through.
If it were such a little female...
Cang Ming's Adam's apple rolled violently, and his face instantly turned red, all the way to the root of his neck.
There was a huge, unspeakable regret in my heart.
If he had insisted on honoring the engagement, would this adorable little rabbit be his now?
Cang Jue was watching her brother go crazy with cold eyes, but she was keenly aware that something was wrong with the way Cang Ming looked at his wife.
That is the unique obsession and amazement that a male feels when he sees the female he likes.
"Hmph."
Cang Jue snorted coldly, her golden eyes instantly narrowed, and the air pressure around her body dropped sharply.
He took a step forward, and his tall body stood directly in front of Cang Ming.
Isolating his view of Shen Ruqing, he released SS-level terrifying pressure and warned coldly: "Cang Ming, pay attention to your eyes.
This is your future sister-in-law and my mistress, you should respect her. "
"Sister-in-law...sister-in-law?"
Cang Ming was shocked by his brother's pressure and took two steps back, his face turned pale.
Only then did he sadly realize that he was a step too late.
The goddess has not only become a sister-in-law, but also a treasure in the palm of the eldest brother's hand.
In the end, he couldn't vent his anger to Shen Ruobing, and he didn't even dare to look at Shen Ruqing again, and walked away dejectedly, his back looking extremely embarrassed.
Shen Ruobing's appeal was rejected and he was taken to the second prison on the same day.
That night, the night was like ink.
Shen Ruqing lay on the bed and fell asleep, but her consciousness was pulled by that familiar force again.
This time, it is no longer an icy snowfield, but a luxurious mansion on the Empire Star, full of cold and hard metal style.
Mo Lin has returned from exile and is in a restless period of mental instability.
The bedroom was in a mess, and the expensive furniture was smashed to pieces.
Mo Lin was sitting on the bedside with his shirtless body, his silver hair messy, and his red eyes like a wounded and extremely dangerous lone wolf, surrounded by violent thunder.
Shen Ruqing stood at the door, her heart beating fast.
Although she was scared, she thought that in reality Mo Lin had begun to doubt her and even chased Cang Jue to her villa.
If she doesn't completely dispel his doubts and make him think that "dreams are dreams and reality is reality," she will overturn sooner or later.
"Fight."
Shen Ruqing took a deep breath, uncharacteristically.
She did not run away in fear like she would in reality, but rushed forward boldly, like a moth rushing to the flame, and took the initiative to hug the male who was on the verge of rage.
"Mo Lin..."
